critical_code_review_comments: Grid endpoint pluralization: canonical URL is /api/admin/attendance/monthly-grid/{company_id}/{month}, not /api/admin/attendance-grid — helpful to document for future testers.
Factory return payload nests statutory particulars under 'firm' (not 'particulars') and totals under 'summary' — testers should use these keys.
